pipeline.title: Verify output
pipeline.detail: new or changed MP3 in active work folder

pipeline.title: Commit state
pipeline.detail: remove queue item or append archive

gates.title: Subprocess gate
gates.on_failure: retry eligible YouTube requests with alternate cookie mode

gates.title: Artifact gate
gates.condition: at least one MP3 in the active work folder is new or changed

gates.title: Metadata gate
gates.on_failure: preserve recoverable MP3 for a later retry

gates.title: Publication gate
gates.condition: stamped MP3 reaches the library folder

gates.title: Retention gate
gates.condition: date and source URL tags are both readable
gates.on_failure: keep the file; deletion is fail-safe
